raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the obituary year, normalizing “’13” as 1913 instead of 2013 for James A. Donohoe III, and also proposed corroborating with an unrelated obituary (Opsahl-Kostel, a different James A. Donohoe who died in 2018 in South Dakota). This mis-normalization and poor disambiguation would lead to the incorrect conclusion that James died before Madame Pasca, when he actually died in 2013, long after her 1914 death.
